title: Visitors' base under the mountains at Dulce
summary: Mario Woods tells of Visitors' base under the mountains at Dulce, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Somebody told me long ago about that very thing that that these visitors already had a place picked out where they wanted to reside

plain: Mario Woods is an Air Force veteran who says he was taken by aliens decades ago. On Jesse Michels' podcast he said that someone told him long ago that these visitors had already picked out a place to live, under the mountains at Dulce, a small town in New Mexico. If true, it would mean the visitors have a hidden home on Earth.
